label: ACCEPT
reason: Every package's test dependency group pins pytest>=9.0.3,<10.0.0 (core, langchain, anthropic, openai, groq, text-splitters, langchain_v1) and nothing in CI or scripts enforces it, so a new partner package copying a stale pin is worth a flag. The sole outlier, libs/standard-tests/pyproject.toml, is a pytest plugin listing pytest as an uncapped runtime dependency, a one-off case rather than a recurring category. Hesitated with WRONG mixed_group because runtime and dev-group pins are mixed.
